)

Done. Branch `feat/files-upload-retry`, 2 commits, all tests pass (incl. `-race`).

## Root cause
The retry transport only retries when the request body is replayable (`req.GetBody != nil`, pipedrive/retry.go:86). `Files.Add` passes the caller's `io.Reader` straight through, and a multipart body streamed from an `os.Open`-ed file (pipe, or any non-`bytes.Reader`/`Buffer`/`strings.Reader` reader) can't be replayed after the first attempt — so 429s fail immediately. This is the same class of bug fixed for `CallLogs.AddRecording` and v2 product images in 1.0.3 via `internal/multipartbody`; `Files` never got the ergonomic wrapper.

## Fix
- `v1.Files.AddFile(ctx, fileName, content io.Reader, opts...)` — builds the multipart body itself and encodes it into a replayable `*bytes.Reader`, so uploads retry under the configured `RetryPolicy` even when the content can only be read once (mirrors `AddRecording` ergonomics).
- Association options: `WithFileDealID/PersonID/OrganizationID/ProductID/ActivityID/LeadID/ProjectID` (validated client-side, matching recent hardening).
- `WithFilesRequestOptions` now returns a `FilesRequestOption` union (source-compatible) so it also applies to `AddFile`.
- `multipartbody.NewFileWithFields` extends the internal helper with extra form fields (deterministic key order); `NewFile` delegates to it.
- `Files.Add` is unchanged as the raw escape hatch; README/CHANGELOG now state the replayability rule explicitly.

## Testing
- `TestFilesService_AddFile_RetriesOn429WithNonSeekableContent`: end-to-end 429→200 with `io.Pipe` content; asserts 2 attempts, identical complete bodies, per-attempt multipart parse.
- Happy path with form fields + request options, validation cases, `multipartbody` unit tests, plus new rows in `id_test.go`/`options_line_coverage_test.go`.
- `go test -race ./...`, `go vet`, `gofmt` clean; golangci-lint unavailable offline (GOPROXY=off).

## Migration
None — additive API. Users should switch `client.Files.Add(ctx, multipartBody, contentType)` → `client.Files.AddFile(ctx, name, file)` to get retries.
